answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, tarnishing from bright to dull copper. A fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight withers like a vine on a bare ledge the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill.
